activities.title: Listen. Maya shows Ingrid the new flat. Write a word or number in each gap.

data.script: Maya: Come in, Ingrid! This is the living room. … Ingrid: I love the yellow sofa! And what a big shelf! … Maya: Yes, it has space for two hundred books. … Ingrid: Where is your science laboratory? … Maya: In the basement! It's a bit dark, but very quiet. … Ingrid: And this door? … Maya: That's the balcony. You can see the sea from there! … Ingrid: Beautiful! Where does Kili sleep when he visits? … Maya: On the roof, of course. He says it's the best bedroom in the city!

The girl in the green shirt with a magnifying glass. … Maya: That is Maya. Maya is looking at something very small. … Diego: And who is the girl with fair hair and a dark blue jacket? … Maya: That is Ingrid. Look, Ingrid is reading the plan for the day. … Diego: And who is the girl with black plaits and a purple shirt? … Maya: That is Lia. Look, Lia is jumping with a skipping rope. … Diego: And who is the big black bird with a white collar? … Maya: That is Kili. Look, Kili is carrying a letter. … Diego: And who is the man in the blue shirt? … Maya: That is Mr Vega. Look, Mr Vega is showing the way to the sports centre.
